patch_description: Replace finite-difference constraint derivatives and the narrowly focused perturbed-grid portfolio with analytic derivatives plus a compact set of staggered row seeds.  Alternating five/six-circle layers approximate the triangular-lattice interior while moving the short-row defect among layers changes the boundary contact graph.  This directly explores the unequal-radius configurations that are unavailable from a nearly square 5-by-5 scaffold.  The analytic Jacobian both improves SLSQP convergence and leaves enough runtime for several distinct topologies.
